anomalies.observed: C59, the bulk capacitor drawn next to the VS pin (22) of the Nutrient-A TMC2209 driver U6, is given the value 220n.
anomalies.expected: The three TMC2209 driver blocks are identical (same ANKO_A200SX pump, same 110 mΩ sense resistors, same R24/R25-style VREF divider), and the corresponding bulk capacitors on the other two drivers are 220µ (C58 at U5, C60 at U7); C59 should also be 220µ.

evidence.quote: Peristaltic Pump Drivers / pH Pump: C58 220µ
Peristaltic Pump Drivers / Nutrient Pump A: C59 220n
Peristaltic Pump Drivers / Nutrient Pump B: C60 220µ

anomalies.impact: The Nutrient-A stepper driver has roughly three orders of magnitude less local bulk capacitance on the 24 V motor rail, so pump acceleration/chopping can cause supply droop and ringing, potentially tripping driver undervoltage or producing erratic dosing relative to the pH-Down and Nutrient-B channels.

anomalies.observed: In the 'Water Height Sensor' block, PR1 (TF-Luna LiDAR) is drawn wired through connector H4 to the main I2C bus labels I2C_SDA / I2C_SCL.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the LiDAR is documentation only and not wired: 'the r2 netlist shows PR1 with on_board: no, in_bom: yes, and all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design.'

evidence.quote: Water Height Sensor: PR1 LIDAR ... H4 PB_1.25mm ... I2C_SDA / I2C_SCL
the r2 netlist shows PR1 with on_board: no, in_bom: yes, and all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design.

anomalies.impact: If a TF-Luna module is fitted it would appear as an extra device on the main I2C bus (shared with the EZO-RTD, BME280 and BH1750), contrary to the intended design in which the LiDAR is unconnected and water level is read by the HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor.
